title: POV: you wake up and gravity is gone
premise: First person: you wake up and Earth's gravity has switched off. Your room, your street, then the sky itself.

pov.text: you wake up and gravity is gone

intro.title: POV: you wake up and *gravity is gone*

beats.caption: Your alarm rings. But it's up on the ceiling.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: You look down. Your bed is a meter below you.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: You reach for your phone. It drifts away.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: You catch it. Then Mom sends a text.

hands.phone_text: MOM: why is the dog on the ceiling??

beats.head: float

beats.caption: Your dog paddles in the air. It looks so confused.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: You push off the wall. Way too hard.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Outside, cars are lifting off the road.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Your neighbor hugs a lamp post. He won't let go.
beats.head: shake

beats.caption: Your water turns into a wobbly ball, like on the space station.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: But here's the scary part. The air is floating away too.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: Gravity is the only thing that holds our air down.
beats.head: breathe

stat.label: OF OUR AIR IS HELD DOWN BY GRAVITY

beats.caption: The window bursts open. The wind pulls you out.
beats.head: run

beats.caption: You're not falling down. You're falling up.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Earth spins at up to 1,670 km/h. Nothing holds you to it now.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Clouds slide past under your feet.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: The air is thin up here. Each breath feels empty.
beats.head: shake

stat.label: THE AIR YOU GET 8 KM UP

beats.caption: Your phone buzzes one last time.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Above you, the blue sky turns black.
beats.head: float

beats.caption: Then something grabs your ankle. And pulls.
beats.head: fall
